summary: A weekly Wednesday night at Sly Grog Lounge in Asheville billed as an 'anything-goes' electronic jam (synths, samplers, laptops, DJ gear) hosted by a DJ going by 'Disco Goddess.' It reads as a drop-in, DJ-led open-jam night for whoever shows up rather than a fixed community of returning members.

evidence.note: 20 near-identical weekly listings (2025-12-18 to 2026-04-30) describe it only as 'an anything-goes electronic jam hosted by Disco Goddess' with no mention of members, regulars, dues, or sign-up forms.

Tags are dominated by host/format descriptors ('Hosted By DJ', 'DJ Led', 'Hosted By Disco Goddess', 'Drop In Friendly', 'Anything Goes', 'Open Electronic Jam') rather than any community/membership language.
Only one named person recurs across all listings: the host DJ 'Disco Goddess'; no other players, regulars, or a group name are ever named.

WebSearch for 'Weird Wednesday Sly Grog Lounge Asheville jam' and for 'Disco Goddess Asheville DJ Sly Grog' turned up no dedicated website, Facebook group/page, Meetup, or Instagram for this event or a 'Weird Wednesday' community - only the recurring Mountain Xpress listing itself and unrelated Sly Grog show listings.

Direct fetch of the Mountain Xpress listing page returned a 403 (site blocks non-browser fetches), so no additional detail beyond the scraped summary/description was available from the source page itself.
